title: Running Commentary on Torah 25 — Mana d'Lo Shavya l'Chavla
hebrewTitle: פירוש רץ על תורה 25 — מנא דלא שויא לחבלא
author: Pettek Nanach
methodology: Direct line-by-line gloss of the Rebbe's text.

beginner.en: **The ma'amar**: **Athenians**: **'achavi lan mana d'lo shavya l'chavla'** ('Show us a utensil not worth the damage it causes'). R' Yehoshua **brought a **budya** (mat) and spread it — it wouldn't fit through the gate. Said: **'aisu mara u'sasru'** (bring a pick and break the gate!). That is the utensil not worth the damage.

intermediate.en: **Bechoros 8b**: Show us **mana d'lo shavya l'chavla** — R"Y brought **budya** (mat), spread it, doesn't fit gate → "bring pick, break gate": mana not worth its damage.
intermediate.he: **בכורות ח:**: "הראנו מנא שלא שווה לחבלה" — ר"י הביא **בודיא** (מחצלת), פרשה, לא נכנסת → "הביאו מרא לסתור": מנא שלא שווה לחבלה.

beginner.en: **Rashi**: **achavi lan mana d'lo shavya l'chavla** = a utensil not worth the damage it causes; **budya** = mat; **lo ayil b'tar'a** = longer/wider than the gateway; **aisu mara u'sasru** = break down the gate-frame and wall until it enters.

intermediate.en: Rashi: mana not worth damage; budya=mat; doesn't fit gate; break wall→enter.
intermediate.he: רש"י: מנא לא שווה לחבלה; בודיא=מחצלת; לא נכנסה; לסתור הכותל.

beginner.en: **Opening Mishnah**: **"Mishe'charav Beis ha'Mikdash batel ha'shamir v'nofes tzufim v'ha'emunah"** (Mishnah Sotah 48a). 'Since the Beis ha'Mikdash was destroyed, the **shamir**, the **nofes tzufim** (flowing honey), and **emunah** have ceased.'

intermediate.en: **Mishnah Sotah 48a**: since churban BH"M — **batel ha'shamir** + **nofes tzufim** + **emunah**.
intermediate.he: **משנה סוטה מח.**: משחרב בהמ"ק — **בטל השמיר + נופת צופים + אמונה**.

beginner.en: **"א. Every person must **extract himself from ha'medameh** (imagination) and **ascend to the sechel**. Pursuing ha'medameh = **sherirus ha'lev** — following the imaginings of the heart. Exiting sherirus ha'lev, breaking the **lev ha'even** — that is bechina of **shamir** (the hard stone-cutting creature): subdues the even, halts the ta'avos dimyonios, and follows the sechel."** **"While one hasn't **brought the sechel into action** (not yet used it), the sechel is **b'ko'ach**. Breaking medameh stands up the sechel's tchunah. When the medameh falls, the sechel rises — **'k'shezeh kam, zeh nofel'** (Rashi)."**

intermediate.en: **α. Extract from ha'medameh → ascend to sechel**. Sherirus ha'lev=following medameh. Breaking lev ha'even=**shamir** (stone-cutter). Sechel b'koach becomes **b'po'al**. "K'shezeh kam, zeh nofel" (Rashi).
intermediate.he: **α. יציאה מהמדמה → עלייה לשכל**. שרירות הלב=מדמה. שבירת לב האבן=**שמיר**. שכל בכוח ל**בפועל**. "כשזה קם, זה נופל" (רש"י).

beginner.en: **"ב. In **every olam and every madreigah** there are these **dimyonos**. They are the **klipos** preceding the fruit, surrounding kedushah — **'saviv resha'im yis'halachun'** (Tehillim 12:9). When one ascends from level to level, he must pass **through these dimyonos** to reach kedushah. As soon as he rises, the klipos of that level awaken and surround him. He must **subdue them** and purify the place."**

intermediate.en: **β. Every olam/madreigah has klipos-dimyonos** surrounding kedushah (Teh 12:9 "saviv resha'im yis'halachun"). Ascent → klipos of new level awaken → must subdue/purify.
intermediate.he: **ב. כל עולם/דרגה יש קליפות־דמיונות** סביב לקדושה (תה' יב, ט "סביב רשעים יתהלכון"). עלייה → קליפות מתעוררות → הכנעה/טיהור.

beginner.en: **"ג. **No two people are equal** — all neshamos are stacked, one above the other, one a **levush** to another: **penimiyus of lower = levush+chitzoniyus of chitzoniyus-elyon**. When one wants to ascend from his level to a higher one, the person standing in that higher level **moves up** to a yet-higher one — impossible for two to share one level. He doesn't move entirely, only his **penimiyus**; his chitzoniyus remains. Likewise the lower: only his penimiyus ascends, becoming levush to the chitzoniyus of what had been the upper."**

intermediate.en: **γ. No 2 people equal** — neshamos stacked, penimiyus=levush to chitzoniyus above. Ascent: upper-person's penimiyus moves up; lower's penimiyus rises to become levush to upper's chitzoniyus.
intermediate.he: **ג. אין שני אנשים שווים** — נשמות מדורגות, פנימיות=לבוש לחיצוניות מעל. עלייה: פנימיות העליון עולה; פנימיות התחתון עולה להיות לבוש לחיצוניות העליון.

scholarly.he: סעיף ג. אין ב' אנשים שווים.

beginner.en: **"ד. Cannot subdue klipos (dimyonos, machshavos, ta'avos, bilbulim, mani'os of the level) except via **gadlus ha'Borei** — as in the kavanos of **'Hodu la'Hashem, kiru bi'shmo'** (I Divrei Ha'Yamim 16:8): this mizmor was instituted to subdue the klipos of **Yetzirah** that rise up against **Asiyah**. Penimiyus Yetzirah → Beriyah; penimiyus Asiyah → chitzoniyus Yetzirah. **Gadlus of the Borei revealed via tzedakah to aniyim hagunim.**"**

intermediate.en: **δ. Subduing klipos via gadlus ha'Borei** (kavanos "Hodu la'Hashem," I DH 16:8 — institutes subdual of Yetzirah-klipos against Asiyah). Pnimiyus Yetzirah→Beriyah; Asiyah→chitzoniyus Yetzirah. Gadlus revealed via **tzedakah** to aniyim hagunim.
intermediate.he: **ד. הכנעת קליפות ע"י גדלות הבורא** (כוונות "הודו לה'", דה"א טז, ח). פנימיות יצירה→בריאה; עשייה→חיצוניות יצירה. גדלות מתגלה ב**צדקה** לעניים הגונים.

scholarly.he: סעיף ד. הודו — כוונות (דה"א טז, ח).

beginner.en: **"Peirush Savei d'Bei Asuna**: **'achavi lan mana d'lo shavya l'chavla'** → budya (mat), spread, doesn't fit gate → **aisu mara u'sasru la'pesach im ha'kosel**. **Budya = b'diyyos ha'lev** — what the heart **invents/fabricates** — **ha'medameh/sherirus ha'lev**. When this **koach ha'medameh** (lev-based) overpowers a person **ascending from lower to upper level** — the klipah (ha'medameh) **doesn't see the damage** already done to the person at the upper level whom he displaces — yet she still pursues. So: **'bring a pick and break the gate'** = break the medameh/lev ha'even via shamir."**

intermediate.en: **Peirush**: budya=b'diyyos ha'lev=ha'medameh/sherirus. Rising → medameh overcomes → doesn't see damage done → must break the gate (shamir breaks lev ha'even).
intermediate.he: **פירוש**: בודיא=בדיות הלב=המדמה/שרירות. עלייה → מדמה גובר → לא רואה נזק → חייב לשבור הפתח (שמיר שובר לב האבן).

beginner.en: **"ה. To subdue the **surrounding klipah of every level**, one must **arouse simchas ha'mitzvah** in himself — remember he merited to draw near to Hashem and to the tzaddikim who bring him near. Via this simchah he breaks the klipah and **enters the second level**."**

intermediate.en: **ε. Arouse simchas ha'mitzvah** — remember one merited to approach Hashem and tzaddikim → breaks klipah → enters next level.
intermediate.he: **ה. עוררות שמחת מצווה** — לזכור את זכות הקירוב לה' ולצדיקים → שובר קליפה → עלייה.

scholarly.he: סעיף ה. שמחת מצווה מכניעה קליפה.

beginner.en: **"(Shayach to os א): **'zivchei Elokim ru'ach nishbarah'** (Tehillim 51:19) — **shvirah of the medameh** = korbanos. **Semichah on the korban**: korbanos come from **behemah**, which also possesses **koach ha'medameh** (animals also have imagination). When a person follows ha'medameh = **ma'aseh behemah mamash**. All **chata'im** come from koach ha'medameh — whence all ta'avos. Therefore when he sins, he brings a korban..."**

intermediate.en: Os α: **"zivchei Elokim ru'ach nishbarah"** (Teh 51:19)=shvirah of medameh=korbanos. Behemah also has koach ha'medameh — following it=ma'aseh behemah. All chata'im from ha'medameh.
intermediate.he: אות א: **"זבחי אלוקים רוח נשברה"** (תה' נא, יט)=שבירת המדמה=קרבנות. בהמה גם בעלת מדמה — הליכה אחריה=מעשה בהמה. כל חטאים מהמדמה.

beginner.en: **"(Shayach to os ב, ג): ascent means passing through dimyonos; even after breaking an upper klipah, when the upper-penimiyus moves up and the lower-penimiyus ascends, **the klipah returns and awakens** afresh. He said at that time: **'this is where people err'** — they think that once they broke a klipah, it's done forever; but at each new level, new klipos arise."**

intermediate.en: Os β-γ: klipos **return/awaken** at each new level despite prior victory. Rabbeinu: **"this is where people err"** — thinking klipah is permanently broken.
intermediate.he: אות ב-ג: קליפות **חוזרות/מתעוררות** בכל דרגה חדשה חרף ניצחון קודם. הרבי: **"כאן טועים"** — שחושבים שנשברה לתמיד.

beginner.en: **"(Shayach to os ג): **No 2 people equal**; ascending raises the upper-person too. This is bechina of **haramah**: one raises/elevates his friend — the tachton's rising pushes the elyon higher, and the elyon's friend higher still — **all the way up**. 'And this is the bechina of haramah' (Rabbeinu's language)."**

intermediate.en: Os γ: **haramah**: lower-man's ascent raises upper, upper's friend raises his friend → all the way up.
intermediate.he: אות ג: **הרמה**: עליית התחתון מרימה את העליון, וחבירו של העליון, עד למעלה.

beginner.en: **R"N editorial**: **"After saying the above — where he referred to all ta'avos of the yetzer hara as **koach ha'medameh** — he said: 'we must **call it by a different name**' — i.e., the yetzer hara should no longer be called *yetzer hara* but **koach ha'medameh**. He said this in a tone of laughter (derech sechok), but I understood he had a complete kavanah in it, which I did not merit to grasp."**

intermediate.en: R"N: Rabbeinu: **rename yetzer hara → koach ha'medameh**. Said b'sechok; R"N: clearly had full kavanah, unable to grasp.
intermediate.he: ר"נ: הרבי: **לכנות יצר הרע → כוח המדמה**. אמר בדרך שחוק; ר"נ: ודאי כוונה שלמה, לא הובנה.
